text:
maya-support: Hi team — Acme (acct ACME-98) opened a ticket saying their procurement requires a signed PO and Net60, but billing couldn't accept the invoice because the payment card on file failed. Customer wants to move forward but is refusing to pay upfront.

mike-billing: Thanks. I pulled the invoice and payment attempts. Invoice INV-2026-1457 for $12,500 is set to Net 60 per sales PO #PO-4589. Card on file produced two failures.

payment-gateway-bot: webhook: payment_attempt failed -> status=declined, code=card_declined, gateway_id=gw_9f3a, txn_id=tx_00098765

maya-support: Customer says their AP team will only approve Net60 with a PO. Sales confirmed PO is signed but AP wants us to capture payment on receipt (they call it "upfront hold"). Conflict between sales terms and AP process.

olivia-sales: Confirming: Sales agreed to Net60 for commercial terms. PO attached (PO-4589) has billing instructions that say "Invoice to be paid within 60 days". However the buyer's AP policy flagged us for new vendor onboarding and requires a card on file while vendor is validated. They declined capture because of mismatched billing address + VAT setup.

jordan-finance: To clarify the ask: customer wants Net60, but their AP refuses to release the invoice unless chargeable balance is authorized immediately. We need decision: (A) honor Net60 and offer temporary credit hold, (B) request customer to provide wire/ACH upfront, or (C) accept card payment and refund/credit later. We also need VAT handling: customer is EU entity and provided VAT ID but our billing shows reverse-charge not applied.

maya-support: Customer shared gateway error details. Paste from them: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-1457
Amount: $12,500.00
PO: PO-4589
Payment attempts:
- 2026-03-11 09:12 UTC: card_declined (code 402)
- 2026-03-11 09:14 UTC: auth_error (code 401)
Gateway resp: {"error":"insufficient_funds","code":"card_declined"}
```

mike-billing: Gateway logs show AVS mismatch on first attempt, then insufficient_funds. The card issuer declined. That's on the customer's side, not us. But we can offer a limited short-term credit while they fix vendor onboarding. Finance, do we have a precedent for temp credit on Net60?

jordan-finance: We have a playbook for "temp net terms" for strategic accounts: finance can provision a one-time conditional credit up to $15k after a quick KYC check and signed credit addendum. Requires approval from Head of Finance and an SLA: they must wire on day 30 if still unpaid, or locked usage. I'll need sales to attach risk justification.

olivia-sales: I'll get the justification. Acme is strategic (expanding trial with 3 teams) and legal already signed the standard SOW. Can you draft the credit addendum template?

jordan-finance: I'll attach a template. For VAT: we need their EU VAT ID validated. If valid, we can issue invoice net of VAT with reverse charge. If not, we must collect VAT up front which complicates AP. Please ask customer to send official VAT proof (VIES screenshot or tax cert).

maya-support: Customer asked for steps from us to unblock: 1) temporary credit while AP verifies PO, 2) instructions for wiring if card can't be used, 3) confirm VAT handling.

mike-billing: Action items: - Olivia: confirm risk note and attach PoC for customer expansion. - Customer: provide VAT proof and secondary payment method (ACH/wire) or authorize card holder. - Jordan: approve conditional credit and send addendum. - Maya: send customer templated instructions (wire details + what to include to match PO).

maya-support: I'll message Acme with this checklist and offer a 7-day temporary credit hold pending docs. I'll copy in finance.

olivia-sales: FYI @maya-support — put in the Sales justification as "risk: low" with expected ARR expansion. I'll DM the Head of Finance for faster approval. :thumbsup:

jordan-finance: If payment still fails after 30 days we'll move to collections per our policy. Also note: we should not change the invoice terms in our system without a signed addendum.

maya-support: Understood. I'll close the loop with the customer and update ticket with the steps and timeline. Will reopen here if they supply VAT proof or wire confirmation.

payment-gateway-bot: webhook: manual_payment_received -> txn_id=tx_00098799, amount=12500, method=wire, ref=PO-4589 (2026-03-13 15:24 UTC)

mike-billing: Payment arrived via wire. Applied to INV-2026-1457. Marking invoice paid and releasing usage locks. Thanks team. :tada:

maya-support: Closing thread — customer satisfied. Noting internal follow-ups: finalize credit addendum template and add a KB for "Net terms vs AP card hold".
